name: mirage
text: College basketball (NCAAB) is already on in the engine's settings, so the scan, auto-bet and bids all include it and I changed nothing. It is not in the list right now because the season is only just starting and the engine has no NCAAB bets listed yet (the list holds NCAAF, NBA, NFL and tennis). I will check once the first games are priced to confirm it shows up and that it can be bet and bid on.
